# 1RMHub

> Free, transparent strength-training calculators. Estimate a one rep max (1RM) from any set, see six published formulas side by side, and get training percentages, RPE-based loads, plate loading, warm-up sets, DOTS scores and strength percentiles from OpenPowerlifting data. No signup.

Every formula is cited to its published source; estimates are shown as a range, not a single "true" number.

## Calculators
- [One rep max calculator](https://1rmhub.com/): 1RM from weight and reps with Epley, Brzycki, Lombardi, Mayhew, O'Conner and Wathan
- [Bench press calculator](https://1rmhub.com/bench-press-calculator/)
- [Squat calculator](https://1rmhub.com/squat-calculator/)
- [Deadlift calculator](https://1rmhub.com/deadlift-calculator/)
- [Overhead press calculator](https://1rmhub.com/overhead-press-calculator/)
- [1RM percentage calculator](https://1rmhub.com/1rm-percentage-calculator/): training weights from 50% to 100%
- [RPE calculator](https://1rmhub.com/rpe-calculator/): 1RM from reps and RPE, and loads for a target RPE
- [Plate calculator](https://1rmhub.com/plate-calculator/): plates per side for any target weight
- [Warm-up calculator](https://1rmhub.com/warm-up-calculator/)
- [DOTS calculator](https://1rmhub.com/dots-calculator/)
- [Strength percentile calculator](https://1rmhub.com/strength-percentile-calculator/): how a lift compares with competitive raw powerlifters
